page.notes: Lower part of the page is cut off; the table continues beyond this part. Line numbers 10, 20, 30 are marginal and not transcribed as text beyond their position. Some Roman numerals in the columns are doubtful in the scan (e.g. XXIIX, XXIX, IIX) and are copied as printed. Brace labels at the right read "Imperatores" (two groups: "duo" and "una"). The first line is a fragment of the previous row. Several roman numerals and the tiny figures in the right columns are uncertain. The cut-off region is not described.
